description: the blindfolded old prophet of the reference picture riding: the same long white hair hanging straight down his back, the same long white beard falling straight down over the chest, the same golden blindfold over his eyes, clearly set apart from the skin of the face, the same golden diadem with a thin halo ring and a small sun on top, the same long cream and white robe with wide sleeves, golden trim and a golden sash at the waist, small golden shoes, nothing in the hands but the reins, no staff; sitting astride a saddle that is not drawn, upright, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the head, chest and hips turned fully to the right; both forearms reaching forward, the two hands together in front of the body holding short reins that end just in front of the hands; only the near leg showing and only one foot in the whole picture: the thigh lying forward and level from the hip to the knee under the robe, the lower leg hanging straight down from the knee with the skirt of the robe falling straight down along it to the ankle, one whole foot in a small golden shoe below the hem with the toes pointing right; the far leg completely hidden and not drawn at all, no second shoe and no second foot; the whole figure from the top of the halo to the sole of the foot inside the picture with room around it; nothing under the rider; isolated figure on a plain background

references.usage: the character's look: this same old man, his face with the golden blindfold, his long white hair and beard, diadem with the halo, robe, sash and colours, drawn the same way; not his standing pose and not the sun staff
